info.name: Retrieves all backups defined on this system

params.name: id
params.description:
the unique identifier (UID) of the backups to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: name
params.description:
The name of the backups to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: sent_min
params.description: The minimum sent data size (in bytes) of the remote backups to return

params.name: sent_max
params.description: The maximum sent data size (in bytes) of the remote backups to return

params.name: state
params.description:
The current state of the backups to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: type
params.description:
The type of backups to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: omnistack_cluster_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: omnistack_cluster_name
params.description:
The name of the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: compute_cluster_parent_hypervisor_object_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: compute_cluster_parent_name
params.description:
The name of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: datastore_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the datastore that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: datastore_name
params.description:
The name of the datastore that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: expires_before
params.description: The latest expiration time before the backups to return expire, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: expires_after
params.description: The earliest expiration time after the backups to return expire, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: virtual_machine_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the virtual_machine that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: virtual_machine_name
params.description:
The name of the virtual_machine that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: virtual_machine_type
params.description:
The type of the virtual_machine that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: virtual_machine_state
params.description:
The state of the virtual_machine that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: size_min
params.description: The minimum size (in bytes) of the backups to return

params.name: size_max
params.description: The maximum size (in bytes) of the backups to return

params.name: application_consistent
params.description: The application-consistent setting of the backups to return

params.name: consistency_type
params.description:
The consistency type of the backups to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: created_before
params.description: The latest creation time before the backups to return were created, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: created_after
params.description: The earliest creation time after the backups to return were created, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: sent_duration_min
params.description: The minimum number of seconds that elapsed while replicating the backups to return

params.name: sent_duration_max
params.description: The maximum number of seconds that elapsed while replicating the backups to return

params.name: sent_completion_before
params.description: The latest time before the replication of backups to return was completed, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: sent_completion_after
params.description: The earliest time after the replication of backups to return was completed, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: unique_size_bytes_min
params.description: The minimum unique size (in bytes) of the backups to return

params.name: unique_size_bytes_max
params.description: The maximum unique size (in bytes) of the backups to return

params.name: cluster_group_id
params.description:
The unique identifiers (UIDs) of the cluster_groups associated with the backups to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: external_store_name
params.description:
The name of the external_stores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: backup_store_type
params.description:
The storage type of the backups to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: associated_cluster
params.description:
The cluster associated with the external_stores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: fields
params.description:
A comma-separated list of fields to include in the returned objects

 Default: Returns all fields

params.name: limit
params.description:
A positive integer that represents the maximum number of results to return

Default: 500

params.name: offset
params.description:
A positive integer that directs the service to start returning the <offset value> instance, up to the limit

Default: 0

params.name: case
params.description:
An indicator that specifies if the filter and sort results use a case-sensitive or insensitive manner

Valid values: sensitive or insensitive

Default: sensitive

params.name: sort
params.description: The name of the field where the sort occurs

params.name: order
params.description:
The sort order preference

Valid values: ascending or descending

Default: descending

info.name: Creates a new virtual machine or replaces the original virtual machine from the specified backup

params.name: bkpId
params.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the backup that you want to retrieve

params.name: restore_original
params.description:
An indicator to show if the original virtual machine gets restored

Valid values:

True: Resets the original virtual machine to the same state it was in when the backup was created

False: Creates a new virtual machine from the backup with the provided name, optionally to a different datastore

Default: false
